buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

4. The attached dimensioned drawing shall form part of the technical specification as Annexure-A. 5. Mandatory Site Visit: All interested bidders shall mandatorily visit the actual site before submission/ope ning of the bid for physical verification and assessment of the complete work requirements. The site visit s hall be carried out in coordination with the authorised representative of the buyer/unit. 6. During the pre-bid site visit, the bidder shall physically inspect and verify both existing gates, cement pillar s, side plinths, mounting points, available dimensions, chain layout, ground conditions, accessibility and pr oposed installation locations. 7. The complete scope of work, technical requirements, design expectations, material specifications, fabricati on details, installation methodology, lettering, unit logo, citation/emblem and other relevant requirements shall be briefed to the bidders during the site visit. No claim of lack of knowledge or inadequate understan ding of the site conditions shall be entertained at a later stage. 8. The bidder shall take all necessary site measurements and assess the feasibility of fabrication, transportati on, erection and installation before submitting the bid. The bidder shall be solely responsible for the correc tness of measurements and assessment of site conditions. 9. The bidder shall specify the proposed MS square-pipe sections, steel plate thickness, support members, ch ain details and finishing system in the technical offer. 10. Fabrication shall commence only after approval of the detailed fabrication drawing and material specificati ons by the authorised technical representative. 11. The overhead signboard shall display the approved unit name and unit logo on both faces. The lower steel plate panels on both sides shall display the approved unit citation/emblem and inscription. 12. The quoted price shall include all materials, fabrication, welding, grinding, lettering, painting, transportatio n, installation, labour, tools, tackles, fixing accessories and site cleaning for both gates. 13. The overhead structures shall be securely mounted above the existing cement pillars, and the steel poles shall be fixed on the existing plinths using a technically suitable and approved arrangement. 14. All exposed steel surfaces shall receive suitable anti-corrosive primer and outdoor-grade paint. 15. The completed work shall be inspected for dimensions, material compliance, workmanship, fixing, letterin g, unit logos, citation panels and finish before acceptance. 16. The supplier shall provide a 24-month warranty against manufacturing defects and defective workmanship , subject to the approved contract conditions. 17. The bidder shall submit a point-by-point compliance statement against the technical specifications and all Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC). 18. The quoted price shall be inclusive of all materials, accessories, labour, transportation, fabrication and inst allation required for completion of both gates. No additional payment shall be admissible on account of sit e conditions, measurements or any requirement already covered under the scope of work. .
